data.body: Anti-pattern scan: 2 other test files (test-ticket-migrate-brainstorm-tags.sh, test-brainstorm-tag-flow.sh) use the old 3-field PIL format, but these test the migration script which reads raw ticket data directly (not via _ticket_has_pil). Their fixtures intentionally represent historical PILs from before the Gap analysis field existed — they do not need updating. The new required field is enforced by _ticket_has_pil for brainstorm:complete tag writes.
